items.markdown:
`UK passport holders can visit Thailand tourist-free for up to 60 days, register via the digital arrival card, or apply online for longer stays`.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=64cd03802f080d54bb16df93.) [[1]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=64cd03802f080d54bb16df93.)[[2]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information)[[3]](https://cibtvisas.co.uk/thailand-visa)

Entry Requirements & Short Stays

- **Visa Exemption:** British citizens get up to 60 days of tourist entry without a prior visa.
- **Digital Arrival Card:** Submit the free online Thailand Digital Arrival Card within 3 days before you fly.
- **Document Check:** Keep your passport valid for at least 6 months, show one blank page, and have proof of return tickets and funds (10,000 THB per person).[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=64cd03802f080d54bb16df93.) [[1]](https://www.siam-legal.com/thailand-visa/thailand-tourist-visa.php)

Extended and Long-Term Visas

- **E-Visa Portal:** Apply for standard tourist, business, or long-term visas online through the [Thai E-Visa Official Website](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/).
- **Destination Thailand Visa (DTV):** Digital nomads can apply for a 5-year multi-entry long-term stay.
- **Extensions:** Standard 60-day entries can be extended locally at an immigration office for an extra 30 days.[](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/) [[1]](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/)[[2]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=65bb7713d0737318de2bab23)[[3]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-e-visa)[[4]](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements)[[5]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-tourist-visa)

If you tell me your **exact trip length** and **purpose of travel** (tourism, work, or digital nomad), I can help you find the right visa process.
